Return all distinct IC50 activity records (in nM) against human Histone deacetylase 6 (CHEMBL1865, SINGLE PROTEIN, Homo sapiens) where the compound has a canonical SMILES and the source document has a PubMed ID or DOI. For each record, output compound_chembl_id, canonical_smiles, compound_key, pubmed_id_or_doi, assay_description, standard_type, standard_relation, standard_value, standard_units, activity_comment, target_chembl_id, target_name, and target_organism.
